adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop iterates over every `destination` in `event.destinationCalendar`. For entries without `destination.credentialId`, it falls back to `destinationCalendarCredentials = this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and then runs `createEvent(c, event)` for *each* matching credential. Because this happens per destination entry, having multiple destination entries with no `credentialId` but the same `integration` will repeat the same "create in all credentials of that integration" logic multiple times, producing duplicate calendar events (and no `externalId` is passed to disambiguate/target a specific calendar).
